experiment_name: [041/120] WEB in TUNNEL Mode (Legacy 3DES-CBC SHA1 (NIST Critical Fail), wan_standard)

violations: 3DES/DES encryption is obsolete and vulnerable to Sweet32 attack (NIST SP 800-77 Rev. 1 Section 3.1).
SHA-1 is deprecated by NIST; SHA-2 or AEAD (GCM) is required.
Diffie-Hellman Group 2 provides < 2048-bit key exchange strength, violating NIST requirements.
Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) is disabled; compromise of long-term key compromises all past sessions.
